label: Seeker Launcher
note: IP-neutral. A shoulder tube that fires seekers, the ship missile's bolt made small (seek, turn_rate, blast_size, splash), and loads them from your grenades: 'item' is the stack it draws on, one per shot (no grenades, no shot). 'mag' 1: one in the tube, and the next goes in over reload_time after each shot while you have grenades. Free fire: off the tube at the crosshair, straight. Lock on: aimed in (right-click), hold a ship or speeder within lock_cone_deg of the crosshair and lock_range m for lock_time seconds (MissileLock, the same lock the ship's seekers use; losing it bleeds the lock off twice as fast) and the next seeker homes on it, bursting within proximity m of it. 'damage' is a hit on a ship's hull (ShipHull), 'personnel_damage' a hit on anything else (a speeder, a person), as ship_missile; where it bursts it goes up like a vehicle (ExplosionFx.big at blast_size) and hurts everything within splash_radius by splash_damage. What it can lock: speeders, the Remnant interceptor in the air and a barracks pad's interceptor (ShipHull.lock_check). Guards hear it out to noise_radius.
